      (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, μ.real (E i ∩ E j)) ≤ μ.real (⋃ i ∈ s, E i)

name: QuadraticCarleson.integral_norm_setIntegral_kernel_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_setIntegral_kernel_le
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (z R C : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (centeredInterval z R))
    (hmean : ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, f y = 0)
    (hKf : ∀ x ∉ tripleCenteredInterval z R,
      IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ K x y * f y) (centeredInterval z R))
    (hregular : ∀ x ∉ tripleCenteredInterval z R,
      ∀ y ∈ centeredInterval z R,
        ‖K x y - K x z‖ ≤ C * |y - z| / |x - y| ^ 2)
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x ↦ ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, K x y * f y)
      (volume.restrict (tripleCenteredInterval z R)ᶜ)) :
    ∫ x in (tripleCenteredInterval z R)ᶜ,
        ‖∫ y in centeredInterval z R, K x y * f y‖ ≤
      (8 * C / 3) * ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, ‖f y‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.norm_setIntegral_kernel_le_decay
statement:
theorem norm_setIntegral_kernel_le_decay
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x z R C : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hx : x ∉ tripleCenteredInterval z R)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (centeredInterval z R))
    (hKf : IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ K x y * f y) (centeredInterval z R))
    (hmean : ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, f y = 0)
    (hregular : ∀ y ∈ centeredInterval z R,
      ‖K x y - K x z‖ ≤ C * |y - z| / |x - y| ^ 2) :
    ‖∫ y in centeredInterval z R, K x y * f y‖ ≤
      (2 * C * R / |x - z| ^ 2) *
        ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, ‖f y‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.norm_setIntegral_kernel_sub_center_le

    (hbound : ∀ y ∈ centeredInterval z R,
      ‖(K x y - K x z) * f y‖ ≤ D * ‖f y‖) :

      D * ∫ y in centeredInterval z R, ‖f y‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_lower
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_lower
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} {I : ι} {j : ℤ}
    (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_lt_two_mul
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_lt_two_mul
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} {I : ι} {j : ℤ}
    (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_upper
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_length_upper
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} {I : ι} {j : ℤ}
    (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :
    length I < (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_lengths_comparable
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_lengths_comparable
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} {I J : ι} {j : ℤ}
    (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j)
    (hJ : J ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :
    length I < 2 * length J ∧ length J < 2 * length I

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_reciprocal_bounds
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_reciprocal_bounds
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} (hlength : ∀ I, 0 < length I)
    {I : ι} {j : ℤ} (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ < (length I)⁻¹ ∧
      (length I)⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleClass_sq_bounds
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleClass_sq_bounds
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} (hlength : ∀ I, 0 < length I)
    {I : ι} {j : ℤ} (hI : I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * j) ≤ (length I) ^ 2 ∧
      (length I) ^ 2 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (j + 1))

theorem dyadicAtomScaleIndex_mem

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScaleIndex_unique
statement:
theorem dyadicAtomScaleIndex_unique

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicAtomScale_mono_of_length_le

theorem dyadicAtomScale_mono_of_length_le

theorem mem_dyadicAtomScaleClass_iff {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ}
    {I : ι} {j : ℤ} :
    I ∈ dyadicAtomScaleClass length j ↔
      (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ length I ∧ length I < (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)

name: QuadraticCarleson.mem_dyadicAtomScaleClass_iff_index_eq
statement:

      dyadicAtomScaleIndex length hlength I = j

statement:
theorem mem_dyadicAtomScaleClass_iff_normalized
    {ι : Type*} {length : ι → ℝ} {I : ι} {j : ℤ} :

      1 ≤ length I / (2 : ℝ) ^ j ∧ length I / (2 : ℝ) ^ j < 2

theorem mem_dyadicAtomScaleClass_of_length_eq_lower

name: QuadraticCarleson.not_mem_dyadicAtomScaleClass_of_length_eq_upper

    ‖∫ t, p t * phase (quadraticTTStarPhase lam μ x y t)‖ ≤

name: QuadraticCarleson.cutoffBoundaryOperator_enorm_le_maximal
statement:
theorem cutoffBoundaryOperator_enorm_le_maximal
    (lam : ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ y, cutoffBoundaryKernel lam ρ (x - y) * f y‖ₑ ≤
      8 * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_enorm_le_maximalTruncation_add_maximal
statement:
theorem finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_enorm_le_maximalTruncation_add_maximal
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (B : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock lam j B f x‖ₑ ≤
      2 * quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation lam f x +
        16 * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_eq_truncations_add_boundaries
statement:
theorem finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_eq_truncations_add_boundaries
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (B : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hfi : Integrable f) (x : ℝ) :
    finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock lam j B f x =
      quadraticHilbertTrunc lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)) f x -
      quadraticHilbertTrunc lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2)) f x +
      (∫ y, cutoffBoundaryKernel lam
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2)) (x - y) * f y) -
      ∫ y, cutoffBoundaryKernel lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)) (x - y) * f y

name: QuadraticCarleson.lowOscillatoryKernel_consecutive_eq_truncations_add_boundaries
statement:
theorem lowOscillatoryKernel_consecutive_eq_truncations_add_boundaries
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (B : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    lowOscillatoryKernel lam B (fun r ↦ j + (r : ℤ)) t =
      (if (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3) < |t| then
          phase (lam * t ^ 2) / (t : ℂ) else 0) -
      (if (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2) < |t| then
          phase (lam * t ^ 2) / (t : ℂ) else 0) +
      cutoffBoundaryKernel lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2)) t -
      cutoffBoundaryKernel lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)) t

name: QuadraticCarleson.harmonicPhaseSum_endpoint_error_le
statement:
theorem harmonicPhaseSum_endpoint_error_le {N k : ℕ} (ell : ℤ) {τ : ℝ}
    (hkn : k ≤ N) (hτ : 1 / 4 ≤ τ) :
    ‖((1 / (N : ℂ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc k N,
        phase (2 * (ell : ℝ) * j * ((k : ℝ) + τ)) / (((k : ℝ) + τ - j : ℝ) : ℂ)) -
      harmonicPhaseSum N k ell τ‖ ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.harmonicPhaseSum_error_le
statement:
theorem harmonicPhaseSum_error_le {N k : ℕ} {ell : ℤ} {τ : ℝ}
    (hN : 100 ≤ N) (hk : (k : ℝ) ≤ 7 * (N : ℝ) / 10) (hτ : τ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hbohr : torusNorm ((ell : ℝ) * τ) ≤ 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ 100 * N)) :
    ‖harmonicPhaseSum N k ell τ - harmonicReciprocalSum N k τ‖ ≤
      (16 * Real.pi / (2 : ℝ) ^ 100) * (Real.log N / N)

name: QuadraticCarleson.harmonicPhaseSum_error_relative
statement:
theorem harmonicPhaseSum_error_relative {N k : ℕ} {ell : ℤ} {τ : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hkn : k ≤ N) (hτ : τ < 1)
    (hbohr : torusNorm ((ell : ℝ) * τ) ≤ 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ 100 * N)) :
    ‖harmonicPhaseSum N k ell τ - harmonicReciprocalSum N k τ‖ ≤
      paperPhaseError * reciprocalMass (N - k) τ / N

      ∑' i : ι, paperLowBadAtomMaximal B (levelAtom A f k (z i) (R i)) (z i) (R i) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.PositiveLowFullEstimate.integral_paperLowCZKernel_eq_sum_fixedHeights

theorem integral_paperLowCZKernel_eq_sum_fixedHeights
    {b : ℝ → ℂ} (hb : LocallyIntegrable b) (B : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem exists_eventually_zero_height_integrands

name: QuadraticCarleson.OscillatoryReduction.exists_spatial_bound
statement:
theorem exists_spatial_bound (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem hasSum_oscillatoryIntegrals (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)

      (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam r hlam) t : ℂ) * phase (lam * t ^ 2))
      (∫ y, highPassKernel lam hlam (x - y) * f y)

statement:
theorem paperOscillatoryAction_eq_integral (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)

name: QuadraticCarleson.CanonicalScaleAtoms.integral_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale
statement:
theorem integral_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale

    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) :
    (∫ y, canonicalLevelBadPart A f k y) =

name: QuadraticCarleson.CanonicalScaleAtoms.integral_fixedHeight_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale
statement:
theorem integral_fixedHeight_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale
    {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) (r : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t, canonicalLevelBadPart A f k (x-t) *
      (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam r hlam) t : ℂ) * phase (lam*t^2)) =
      ∑' j : ℤ, ∫ t, stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k (x-t) *
        (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam r hlam) t : ℂ) * phase (lam*t^2)

theorem integral_kernel_mul_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum

    (hKi : Integrable (fun y ↦ K y * canonicalLevelBadPart A f k y)) :
    (∫ y, K y * canonicalLevelBadPart A f k y) =

statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.CanonicalScaleAtoms.paperOscillatoryAction_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale
statement:
theorem paperOscillatoryAction_canonicalLevelBadPart_eq_tsum_scale
    {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam (canonicalLevelBadPart A f k) x =
      ∑' j : ℤ, paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam (stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.CanonicalScaleAtoms.tsum_lintegral_enorm_kernel_mul_scale
statement:
theorem tsum_lintegral_enorm_kernel_mul_scale

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.mem_L
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.mem_Q
statement:
theorem mem_Q {B : ℕ} {τ m : ℤ} :
    m ∈ Q B τ ↔
      τ * (B : ℤ) ≤ m ∧ m < τ * (B : ℤ) + (B : ℤ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.mem_R
statement:
theorem mem_R {B c : ℕ} {τ j : ℤ} (hB : 0 < B) :
    j ∈ R B c τ ↔
      -(τ * (B : ℤ)) - (c : ℤ) - 3 * (B : ℤ) + 2 ≤ 2 * j ∧
        2 * j ≤ (c : ℤ) + 2 * (B : ℤ) - τ * (B : ℤ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.mem_R_center4_bound
statement:
theorem mem_R_center4_bound {B c : ℕ} {τ j : ℤ} (hB : 0 < B)

    |4 * j - center4 B τ| ≤ 2 * (c : ℤ) + 5 * (B : ℤ) - 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.mem_R_sdiff_S_imp_mem_L_or_tooLarge

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryMiddleRange.not_mem_S_iff_mem_L_or_tooLarge
statement:
theorem not_mem_S_iff_mem_L_or_tooLarge {B c : ℕ} {m j : ℤ} :

      j ∈ L B c m ∨ (c : ℤ) + 2 * (B : ℤ) < m + 2 * j

    ‖stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k x‖ₑ =
      ∑' c : stoppingCell f,

    (∫⁻ x, ‖stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k x‖ₑ) =
      atomScaleMass (stoppingLength (f := f))
        (fun c ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, ‖levelAtom A f k (stoppingCenter c) (stoppingLength c) x‖)) j

        (fun c ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖levelAtom A f k (stoppingCenter c) (stoppingLength c) x‖ₑ) j

name: QuadraticCarleson.CanonicalScaleAtoms.tsum_sparseBlock_stoppingScaleLevelBadPart_mass_le
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.centeredMaximal_excision
statement:
theorem centeredMaximal_excision
    (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hF : Measurable F)
    (hmassTop : (∫⁻ x, F x) ≠ ∞) (hmassZero : (∫⁻ x, F x) ≠ 0)
    (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hEzero : volume E ≠ 0)
    (hEtop : volume E ≠ ∞) :
    let mass := ∫⁻ x, F x
    let b := 2048 * mass / volume E
    let H := {x | b < centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal F x}
    let Hwide := {x | (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 32 <
      centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (H.indicator 1) x}
    volume E / 2 ≤ volume (E \ (H ∪ Hwide))

name: QuadraticCarleson.finiteMaxRep_compact_level_bound
statement:
theorem finiteMaxRep_compact_level_bound
    (n : ℕ) (T : Fin (n + 1) → TestOperator) (A : ℝ)
    (hT : FiniteSparseMaximalHypothesis T A)
    {p r ε a : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) (hr : 1 < r)
    (hpr : p < r) (hε : 0 < ε) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : L0Infinity) (K E : Set ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hEK : E ⊆ K)
    (hElevel : E ⊆ {x | a < measurableFiniteMaxRep T f (fun j ↦ hT.2.1 j f) x})
    (hmassZero : (∫⁻ y, ‖f y‖ₑ) ≠ 0) (hEzero : volume E ≠ 0) :
    let mass := ∫⁻ y, ‖f y‖ₑ
    let b := (2048 * mass / volume E).toReal
    let C := A * holderConjugate p + ε
    let common : ℝ≥0∞ :=
      8 *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ holderConjugate r *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (4 * holderConjugate r /
              (holderConjugate r - 1)) * mass *
            ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ (holderConjugate r - 1)))) ^
              (1 / holderConjugate r) *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (r / p) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (centeredHardyLittlewoodRpowConstant (r / p))) ^
            (1 / r)
    ENNReal.ofReal a * (volume E / 2) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal C * common *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((volume E).toReal ^ (1 / r) *
          ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / holderConjugate r))

      (2 : ℝ) ^ 36 * r ^ (1 / holderConjugate r) *

name: QuadraticCarleson.finiteSparse_common_normalization
statement:
theorem finiteSparse_common_normalization
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hr : 1 < r) (hpr : p < r) (m e : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hm0 : m ≠ 0) (hmt : m ≠ ∞) (he0 : e ≠ 0) (het : e ≠ ∞)
    (X : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X) :
    let b := (2048 * m / e).toReal
    let common : ℝ≥0∞ :=
      8 *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ holderConjugate r *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (4 * holderConjugate r /
              (holderConjugate r - 1)) * m *
            ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ (holderConjugate r - 1)))) ^
              (1 / holderConjugate r) *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (r / p) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (centeredHardyLittlewoodRpowConstant (r / p))) ^
            (1 / r)
    common * ENNReal.ofReal (e.toReal ^ (1 / r) * X) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (finiteSparseRawFactor p r * m.toReal * X)

name: QuadraticCarleson.finiteSparse_normalized_factor_le

    2 * (A * holderConjugate p + ε) * finiteSparseRawFactor p r *
        (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / holderConjugate r) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ 37 * (A + ε) * finiteSparseFactor N p r

name: QuadraticCarleson.sparseForm_foliation_leaf_le
statement:
theorem sparseForm_foliation_leaf_le
    {p r b : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 1 < r) (hpr : p < r) (hb : 0 < b)
    {S : Set RealInterval} (hS : IsSparse (1 / 4) S)
    (f g : L0Infinity)
    (hactive : ∀ I : {I : RealInterval // I ∈ S},
      localAverage p g I.1 ≠ 0 → ∃ x ∈ I.1.carrier,
        centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal
          ({y | ENNReal.ofReal b < centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal
            (fun z ↦ ‖f z‖ₑ) y}.indicator 1) x ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 32) :
    sparseForm p f g S ≤
      8 * (
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ holderConjugate r *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (4 * holderConjugate r /
              (holderConjugate r - 1)) * (∫⁻ y, ‖f y‖ₑ) *
            ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ (holderConjugate r - 1)))) ^
              (1 / holderConjugate r) *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (r / p) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (centeredHardyLittlewoodRpowConstant (r / p)) *
            ∫⁻ x, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ r) ^ (1 / r))

name: QuadraticCarleson.sparseForm_indicator_leaf_le_factored
statement:
theorem sparseForm_indicator_leaf_le_factored
    {p r b : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 1 < r) (hpr : p < r) (hb : 0 < b)
    {S : Set RealInterval} (hS : IsSparse (1 / 4) S)
    (f : L0Infinity) (G K : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hGK : G ⊆ K)
    (hactive : ∀ I : {I : RealInterval // I ∈ S},
      localAverage p (setIndicatorL0Infinity G K hG hK hGK) I.1 ≠ 0 →
        ∃ x ∈ I.1.carrier,
          centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal
            ({y | ENNReal.ofReal b < centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal
              (fun z ↦ ‖f z‖ₑ) y}.indicator 1) x ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 32) :
    sparseForm p f (setIndicatorL0Infinity G K hG hK hGK) S ≤
      (8 *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ holderConjugate r *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (4 * holderConjugate r /
              (holderConjugate r - 1)) * (∫⁻ y, ‖f y‖ₑ) *
            ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ (holderConjugate r - 1)))) ^
              (1 / holderConjugate r) *
        ((4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (r / p) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (centeredHardyLittlewoodRpowConstant (r / p))) ^
            (1 / r)) * volume G ^ (1 / r)

statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.quadraticHilbertTrunc_normalize_nonzero
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertTrunc_normalize_nonzero {lam : ℝ} (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (ε : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    quadraticHilbertTrunc lam ε f x =
      quadraticHilbertTrunc (if lam < 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)
        (Real.sqrt |lam| * ε) (fun u ↦ f (u / Real.sqrt |lam|))
        (Real.sqrt |lam| * x)

    quadraticHilbertTrunc (sigma * a ^ 2) ε f x =

      (Real.sqrt |lam| : ℂ) *
        (phase ((if lam < 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
          (Real.sqrt |lam| * t) ^ 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt |lam| * t : ℝ) : ℂ))

    (hchild_disj : ∀ I ∈ S,
      Set.Pairwise (↑(children I) : Set RealInterval)
        (Disjoint on fun J : RealInterval ↦ J.carrier))
    (hchild_sub : ∀ I ∈ S, ∀ J ∈ children I, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier)
    (hbad : ∀ I ∈ S, ∀ J ∈ children I,
      10 * intervalL1Average f I < intervalL1Average f J ∨
        10 * intervalL1Average g I < intervalL1Average g J)
    (htree : Set.Pairwise (↑S) fun I J ↦
      Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier ∨
        (∃ K ∈ children I, J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier) ∨
          ∃ K ∈ children J, I.carrier ⊆ K.carrier) :
    IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑S : Set RealInterval)

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLacey_positiveDyadicCorrelation_le
statement:
theorem krauseLacey_positiveDyadicCorrelation_le (j : ℤ) (x y : ℝ) :
    let R := (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 1)
    ‖∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel (positiveDyadicAmplitude j) 1 (x - t) *
      conj (annularQuadraticKernel (positiveDyadicAmplitude j) 1 (y - t))‖ ≤
      if |y - x| ≤ 2 * R then
        if |y - x| < 1 / 2 then
          2 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / R
        else 2 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / R ^ 2
      else 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLacey_sameScaleCorrelation_le

theorem krauseLacey_sameScaleCorrelation_le
    {R P : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    {p p' : ℝ → ℂ} (hp : ∀ t, HasDerivAt p (p' t) t) (hp' : Continuous p')
    (x y : ℝ)
    (hsupport : Function.support p ⊆
      {t | R / 4 ≤ x - t ∧ x - t ≤ R ∧ R / 4 ≤ y - t ∧ y - t ≤ R})
    (hbound : ∀ t, ‖p t‖ ≤ P) (hbound' : ∀ t, ‖p' t‖ ≤ P / R) :
    ‖∫ t, p t * phase (quadraticTTStarPhase 1 1 x y t)‖ ≤
      if |y - x| ≤ 2 * R then
        if |y - x| < 1 / 2 then P * R else P
      else 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.annularQuadraticKernel_correlation_le_separated
statement:
theorem annularQuadraticKernel_correlation_le_separated
    {a a' b b' : ℝ → ℂ} {r R D : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R) (hrR : r ≤ R / 8) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (ha : ∀ t, HasDerivAt a (a' t) t) (ha' : Continuous a')
    (hb : ∀ t, HasDerivAt b (b' t) t) (hb' : Continuous b')
    (hasupp : Function.support a ⊆ Icc (R / 4) R)
    (hbsupp : Function.support b ⊆ Icc (r / 4) r)
    (hab : ∀ t, ‖a t‖ ≤ D / R) (hab' : ∀ t, ‖a' t‖ ≤ D / R ^ 2)
    (hbb : ∀ t, ‖b t‖ ≤ D / r) (hbb' : ∀ t, ‖b' t‖ ≤ D / r ^ 2)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel a 1 (x - t) *
      conj (annularQuadraticKernel b 1 (y - t))‖ ≤
      if |y - x| ≤ 2 * R then 6 * D ^ 2 / (r * R ^ 2) else 0

      if |y - x| ≤ 2 * R then 6 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / R ^ 2 else 0

    {r R P : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R) (hrR : r ≤ R / 8) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    {p p' : ℝ → ℂ} (hp : ∀ t, HasDerivAt p (p' t) t) (hp' : Continuous p')

      {t | R / 4 ≤ x - t ∧ x - t ≤ R ∧ r / 4 ≤ y - t ∧ y - t ≤ r})

    ‖∫ t, p t * phase (quadraticTTStarPhase 1 1 x y t)‖ ≤

statement:

    (j k : ℤ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j + 3 ≤ k) (I J : RealInterval)
    {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) :
    ‖∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
      conj (krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 j J g x)‖ ≤
      (6 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)) ^ 2) *
        (∫ x in I.centralThird, ‖f x‖) * ∫ x in J.centralThird, ‖g x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyPositiveKernel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem krauseLaceyPositiveKernel_apply (j : ℤ) (x t : ℝ) :
    krauseLaceyPositiveKernel j x t =
      annularQuadraticKernel (positiveDyadicAmplitude j) 1 (x - t)

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyPositiveKernel_mixed_adjoint_le
statement:
theorem krauseLaceyPositiveKernel_mixed_adjoint_le
    (j k : ℤ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j + 3 ≤ k) (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ t, conj (krauseLaceyPositiveKernel k t x) * krauseLaceyPositiveKernel j t y‖ ≤
      6 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)) ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.integral_localizedPiece_cross_collection
statement:
theorem integral_localizedPiece_cross_collection
    (S : Finset RealInterval) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (b : RealInterval → ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) (I : RealInterval)
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hb : ∀ J ∈ S, Integrable (b J)) :
    (∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
      conj (krauseLaceyCollectionAction S scale b x)) =
      ∑ J ∈ S, ∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
        conj (krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (scale J) J (b J) x)

name: QuadraticCarleson.integral_localizedPiece_cross_collection_eq_filter
statement:
theorem integral_localizedPiece_cross_collection_eq_filter
    (T : Finset RealInterval) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (b : RealInterval → ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) (I : RealInterval)
    (hI : I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2))
    (hT : ∀ J ∈ T, J.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale J + 2))
    (hgeometry : ∀ J ∈ T, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hb : ∀ J ∈ T, Integrable (b J)) :
    (∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
      conj (krauseLaceyCollectionAction T scale b x)) =
      ∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
        conj (krauseLaceyCollectionAction
          (T.filter fun J ↦ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier) scale b x)

name: QuadraticCarleson.integral_localizedPiece_cross_eq_zero_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem integral_localizedPiece_cross_eq_zero_of_disjoint
    (j k : ℤ) (I J : RealInterval) (f g : ℝ → ℂ)

    (hJ : J.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2))
    (hdisj : Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier) :
    (∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I f x *
      conj (krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 j J g x)) = 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyCollectionAction_crossPairing_le_generation
statement:
theorem krauseLaceyCollectionAction_crossPairing_le_generation
    (S T : Finset RealInterval) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (a b : RealInterval → ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ I ∈ S, I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale I + 2))
    (hT : ∀ J ∈ T, J.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale J + 2))
    (hlen : ∀ I ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ u ≤ I.length)
    (hdisj : Set.Pairwise (↑T) (Disjoint on RealInterval.carrier))
    (hgeometry : ∀ I ∈ S, ∀ J ∈ T,
      J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    (hsmall : ∀ I ∈ S, ∀ J ∈ T, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier →
      1 ≤ scale J ∧ scale J + 3 ≤ scale I)
    (ha : ∀ I ∈ S, Integrable (a I))
    (hb : ∀ J ∈ T, Integrable (b J))
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hmass : ∀ J ∈ T, (∫ x in J.centralThird, ‖b J x‖) ≤ M * J.length) :
    ‖∫ x, krauseLaceyCollectionAction S scale a x *
      conj (krauseLaceyCollectionAction T scale b x)‖ ≤
      (384 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 * M / (2 : ℝ) ^ u) *
        ∑ I ∈ S, ∫ x in I.centralThird, ‖a I x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece_crossPairing_le_length
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece_cross_collection_le

    (S : Finset RealInterval) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece_cross_collection_le_generation

    (S : Finset RealInterval) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyFiniteScaleMaximal_le
statement:
theorem krauseLaceyFiniteScaleMaximal_le
    {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (S : Fin (n + 1) → Finset RealInterval)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ M)
    (hscale : ∀ i I, I ∈ S i → I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (j i + 2))
    (hdisj : ∀ i, Set.Pairwise (↑(S i) : Set RealInterval)
      (Disjoint on fun I : RealInterval ↦ I.carrier)) (x : ℝ) :
    krauseLaceyFiniteScaleMaximal j S f x ≤ positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound * M

name: QuadraticCarleson.krauseLaceyFixedScale_endpoints
statement:
theorem krauseLaceyFixedScale_endpoints
    (j : ℤ) (S : Finset RealInterval) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf2 : MemLp f 2)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hfTop : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ M)
    (hscale : ∀ I ∈ S, I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2))
    (hdisj : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval)
      (Disjoint on fun I : RealInterval ↦ I.carrier)) :
    (∀ x, ‖krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum j S f x‖ ≤
        positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound * M) ∧
      (let R := (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 1)
       (∫⁻ x, ‖krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum j S f x‖ₑ ^ 2) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (2218647684 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 / R) *
            ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2)

name: QuadraticCarleson.norm_krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum_le
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingExtraction.goodCollection_averages_le

theorem goodCollection_averages_le

    (hsub : ∀ K ∈ S, K.carrier ⊆ I.carrier)
    (hJ : J ∈ goodCollection S f g I) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingExtraction.mem_badDescendants_iff
statement:
theorem mem_badDescendants_iff
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f g : ℝ → ℂ} {I J : RealInterval} :
    J ∈ badDescendants S f g I ↔ J ∈ S ∧ IsBadDescendant f g I J

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingExtraction.mem_stoppingChildren_iff
statement:
theorem mem_stoppingChildren_iff
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f g : ℝ → ℂ} {I J : RealInterval} :
    J ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I ↔
      J ∈ badDescendants S f g I ∧
        ∀ K ∈ badDescendants S f g I, J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier → K = J

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingExtraction.root_insert_stoppingChildren_isSparse

statement:

    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingExtraction.sum_eq_good_add_sum_children
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.badScaleInput_localMass_le
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.badScaleInput_unitWindowMass_le

theorem badScaleInput_unitWindowMass_le

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.badScale_indices_eq_of_ne_zero

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.integrable_badScaleInput

statement:

    (N : Finset RealInterval) (hN : N ⊆ S)
    (hlen : ∀ I ∈ N, I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale I + 2)) :
    (∑ I ∈ N, ∫ x in I.centralThird,
      ‖badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (scale I + 2 - s) x‖) ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyStoppingRecursion.finite_localized_stopping_step
statement:
theorem finite_localized_stopping_step
    (ell₀ : ℤ) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) (S : Finset RealInterval)
    {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hfi : Integrable f) (hgi : Integrable g) (I : RealInterval)
    (hsub : ∀ J ∈ S, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier)
    (hscale : ∀ J ∈ S, J.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale J + 2))
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier) :
    IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑(stoppingStepFamily S f g I) : Set RealInterval) ∧
      (∀ J ∈ goodCollection S f g I,
        intervalL1Average f J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average f I ∧
          intervalL1Average g J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average g I) ∧
      (∀ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I, ∀ x, x ∉ K.carrier →
        localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (childCollection S K) f x = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale S f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) ≤
        (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (goodCollection S f g I) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) +
          ∑ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I,
            ∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (childCollection S K) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ

theorem localizedTailAction_eq_good_add_children
    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) {S : Finset RealInterval} (f g : ℝ → ℂ)
    (I : RealInterval)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (ell : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    localizedTailAction scale S f ell x =
      localizedTailAction scale (goodCollection S f g I) f ell x +
        ∑ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I,
          localizedTailAction scale (childCollection S K) f ell x

theorem localizedTailMaximal_le_good_add_children
    (ell₀ : ℤ) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) {S : Finset RealInterval}

theorem completeFiniteShiftGridTree_stopping_step
    (ell₀ topScale : ℤ) (shift : Fin 3) (maxDepth : ℕ) (q₀ : ℤ)
    {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hfi : Integrable f) (hgi : Integrable g) :
    let S := completeFiniteShiftGridTree topScale shift maxDepth q₀
    let scale := finiteShiftGridScale topScale shift
    let I₀ := finiteShiftGridInterval topScale shift 0 q₀
    IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑(stoppingStepFamily S f g I₀) : Set RealInterval) ∧
      (∀ J ∈ goodCollection S f g I₀,
        intervalL1Average f J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average f I₀ ∧
          intervalL1Average g J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average g I₀) ∧
      (∀ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I₀, ∀ x, x ∉ K.carrier →
        localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (childCollection S K) f x = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale S f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) ≤
        (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale
          (goodCollection S f g I₀) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) +
          ∑ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f g I₀,
            ∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale
              (childCollection S K) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.exists_finiteThreeShiftFamily_localization
statement:
theorem exists_finiteThreeShiftFamily_localization
    (f : L0Infinity) (topScale : ℤ) (depth : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Finset ℤ,
      (∀ I ∈ finiteThreeShiftFamily topScale depth E,
        I.length = dyadicLength (shiftedGridRootLength topScale) depth) ∧
      Set.Pairwise (↑(finiteThreeShiftFamily topScale depth E) : Set RealInterval)
        (Disjoint on fun I : RealInterval ↦ I.centralThird) ∧
      krauseLaceyFixedScaleInput (finiteThreeShiftFamily topScale depth E) f = f

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.exists_finite_threeShift_localizedSum_eq_globalConvolution
statement:
theorem exists_finite_threeShift_localizedSum_eq_globalConvolution
    (f : L0Infinity) (topScale : ℤ) (depth : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : Fin 3 → Finset RealInterval,
      (∀ shift, ∀ I ∈ G shift, ∃ q : ℤ,
        I = finiteShiftGridInterval topScale shift depth q) ∧
      Set.Pairwise (↑(Finset.univ.biUnion G) : Set RealInterval)
        (Disjoint on fun I : RealInterval ↦ I.centralThird) ∧
      ∀ x,
        krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum (topScale - (depth : ℤ))
            (Finset.univ.biUnion G) f x =
          ∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel
            (positiveDyadicAmplitude (topScale - (depth : ℤ))) 1 (x - t) * f t

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.exists_threeShiftForests_globalTail
statement:
theorem exists_threeShiftForests_globalTail
    (f : L0Infinity) (topScale ell : ℤ) (depths : Finset ℕ)
    (maxDepth : ℕ) (hdepths : ∀ depth ∈ depths, depth ≤ maxDepth)
    (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ E : ℕ → Finset ℤ,
      (∀ shift,
        finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift ⊆
          completeFiniteShiftGridForest topScale shift maxDepth
            (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleAddresses depths E shift)) ∧
      (∑ shift : Fin 3,
          localizedTailAction (finiteShiftGridScale topScale shift)
            (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift) f ell x) =
        ∑ depth ∈ depths,
          if (2 : ℝ) ^ ell ≤
              (2 : ℝ) ^ (topScale - (depth : ℤ) + 2) then
            ∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel
              (positiveDyadicAmplitude (topScale - (depth : ℤ))) 1 (x - t) * f t
          else 0

statement:
theorem exists_threeShiftForests_globalTail_all_thresholds

      (∀ shift,
        finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift ⊆
          completeFiniteShiftGridForest topScale shift maxDepth
            (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleAddresses depths E shift)) ∧
      ∀ (ell : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
        (∑ shift : Fin 3,
            localizedTailAction (finiteShiftGridScale topScale shift)
              (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift) f ell x) =
          ∑ depth ∈ depths,
            if (2 : ℝ) ^ ell ≤
                (2 : ℝ) ^ (topScale - (depth : ℤ) + 2) then
              ∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel
                (positiveDyadicAmplitude (topScale - (depth : ℤ))) 1 (x - t) * f t
            else 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.localizedTailAction_finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily
statement:
theorem localizedTailAction_finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily
    (topScale ell : ℤ) (depths : Finset ℕ) (E : ℕ → Finset ℤ)
    (shift : Fin 3) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    localizedTailAction (finiteShiftGridScale topScale shift)
        (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift) f ell x =
      ∑ depth ∈ depths,
        if (2 : ℝ) ^ ell ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (topScale - (depth : ℤ) + 2) then
          krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum (topScale - (depth : ℤ))
            (finiteOneShiftFamily topScale depth (E depth) shift) f x
        else 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.sum_finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily
statement:
theorem sum_finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (topScale : ℤ) (depths : Finset ℕ) (E : ℕ → Finset ℤ) (shift : Fin 3)
    (u : RealInterval → M) :
    (∑ I ∈ finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift, u I) =
      ∑ depth ∈ depths,
        ∑ I ∈ finiteOneShiftFamily topScale depth (E depth) shift, u I

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.sum_fixedScaleLocalizedSum_eq_globalConvolution
statement:
theorem sum_fixedScaleLocalizedSum_eq_globalConvolution
    (f : L0Infinity) (topScale : ℤ) (depth : ℕ) (E : Finset ℤ)
    (hinput : krauseLaceyFixedScaleInput
      (finiteThreeShiftFamily topScale depth E) f = f) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ shift : Fin 3,
        krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum (topScale - (depth : ℤ))
          (finiteOneShiftFamily topScale depth E shift) f x) =
      ∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel
        (positiveDyadicAmplitude (topScale - (depth : ℤ))) 1 (x - t) * f t

statement:
theorem sum_fixedScaleLocalizedSum_finiteOneShiftFamily

    (∑ shift : Fin 3,
        krauseLaceyFixedScaleLocalizedSum j
          (finiteOneShiftFamily topScale depth E shift) f x) =

    (hinput : ∀ depth ∈ depths,
      krauseLaceyFixedScaleInput
        (finiteThreeShiftFamily topScale depth (E depth)) f = f)
    (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ shift : Fin 3,
        localizedTailAction (finiteShiftGridScale topScale shift)
          (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily topScale depths E shift) f ell x) =
      ∑ depth ∈ depths,
        if (2 : ℝ) ^ ell ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (topScale - (depth : ℤ) + 2) then
          ∫ t, annularQuadraticKernel
            (positiveDyadicAmplitude (topScale - (depth : ℤ))) 1 (x - t) * f t
        else 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySharpSmoothAdapter.dyadicHighPass_cutoff_argument
statement:
theorem dyadicHighPass_cutoff_argument (j : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    t / (4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)) = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ (j - 1) * t

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySharpSmoothAdapter.dyadicQuadraticKernel_norm_le_scale
statement:
theorem dyadicQuadraticKernel_norm_le_scale
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySharpSmoothAdapter.exists_eventually_zero_dyadicTail_integrands
statement:
theorem exists_eventually_zero_dyadicTail_integrands
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ r : ℕ, N ≤ r → ∀ y : ℝ,
      ((dyadicPsi (j + (r : ℤ)) (x - y) : ℂ) *
        phase (lam * (x - y) ^ 2)) * f y = 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySharpSmoothAdapter.exists_threeShift_localizedTailActions_eq_positivePartialSum
statement:
theorem exists_threeShift_localizedTailActions_eq_positivePartialSum
    (f : L0Infinity) (j : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : ℕ → Finset ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      (∑ shift : Fin 3,
        KrauseLaceyStoppingRecursion.localizedTailAction
          (KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.finiteShiftGridScale
            (j + (n : ℤ) - 1) shift)
          (KrauseLaceyThreeShiftGrid.finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily
            (j + (n : ℤ) - 1) (Finset.range n) E shift)
          f j x) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ t,
        annularQuadraticKernel (positiveDyadicAmplitude (j + (r : ℤ))) 1
          (x - t) * f t

theorem finiteRadiusSharpMax_enorm_le_smoothHighPassMax_add_maximal

statement:
theorem hasSum_dyadicQuadraticConvolutions_add_nat

statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertTrunc_enorm_le_dyadicRounded_add_maximal
    (lam : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {f : ℝ → ℂ}

      ‖smoothQuadraticHighPass lam (dyadicCeilRadius ε hε) f x‖ₑ +

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySharpSmoothAdapter.quadraticHilbertTrunc_enorm_le_smoothHighPass_add_maximal
statement:

        ∫ y, paperLowCZKernel
            (dyadicModulation m) (dyadicModulation_pos m).ne' B x y *
          stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k y

theorem lacunaryHighContribution_levelSet_le_orlicz
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    (z R : ι → ℝ) (hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun i ↦ centeredInterval (z i) (R i))) :
    volume {x | 1 < paperLacunaryHighContribution lacunaryHighCutoff
      (fun k ↦ disjointLevelAtomSum lacunaryAmplitude f k z R) x} ≤
      lacunaryHighEndpointConstant *
        ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ * paperLog 2 ‖f x‖ ^ 2)

    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) (B c : ℕ) (m : ℤ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∉ fivefoldExceptionalSet (stoppingCenter (f := f)) stoppingLength) :
    ‖lacunaryLowActionAtLevel A f k B m x‖ₑ ≤
      ‖middleRangeLowAction A f k B c m x‖ₑ +
        verySmallLowContributionAtLevel A f k B c x

name: QuadraticCarleson.LacunaryLowAssembly.lacunaryLowActionAtLevel_eq_sum_fixedHeights
statement:
theorem lacunaryLowActionAtLevel_eq_sum_fixedHeights
    {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) (B : ℕ) (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    lacunaryLowActionAtLevel A f k B m x =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (B + 1), ∫ t, canonicalLevelBadPart A f k (x - t) *
        (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex (dyadicModulation m) r
          (dyadicModulation_pos m).ne') t : ℂ) * phase (dyadicModulation m * t ^ 2)

statement:
theorem lacunaryMiddleLowContribution_le_frozen_add_verySmall

statement:

    {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    {k : ℕ} (hAk : 0 ≤ A k) (B c : ℕ) (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    middleRangeLowAction A f k B c m x =
      ∑ j ∈ S B c m, ∫ y,
        paperLowCZKernel (dyadicModulation m) (dyadicModulation_pos m).ne' B x y *
          stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k y

      paperLowCZKernel (dyadicModulation m) (dyadicModulation_pos m).ne' B x y *
        stoppingScaleLevelBadPart A f j k y)

name: QuadraticCarleson.scaledCounterexampleModular_le_secant

name: QuadraticCarleson.exists_normalized_counterexampleSchwartz_modular_witness
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_counterexampleSchwartz_modular_witness
    (Φ : YoungFunction) (hΦ : GrowsSlowerThanEndpoint Φ)
    {c δ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hlevel : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (N : ℝ)) ≤
      volume {x | ENNReal.ofReal (counterexampleHeight c N) ≤
        lacunaryQuadraticCarlesonSchwartz (counterexampleSchwartz N) x})
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < counterexampleHeight (c / 2) N ∧
      HasCompactSupport ((counterexampleHeight (c / 2) N)⁻¹ • counterexampleSchwartz N :
        𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ∧
      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal
        (Φ (‖((counterexampleHeight (c / 2) N)⁻¹ • counterexampleSchwartz N) x‖))) <
        ENNReal.ofReal κ * volume {x | 1 < lacunaryQuadraticCarlesonSchwartz
          ((counterexampleHeight (c / 2) N)⁻¹ • counterexampleSchwartz N) x}

        lacunaryQuadraticCarlesonSchwartz (counterexampleSchwartz N) x})
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ), HasCompactSupport (g : ℝ → ℂ) ∧
      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Φ (‖g x‖))) <

name: QuadraticCarleson.exists_unit_schwartz_modular_witness_of_sequence
statement:
theorem exists_unit_schwartz_modular_witness_of_sequence (Φ : YoungFunction)
    (T : SchwartzNonnegativeOperator) (hT : T.PositivelyHomogeneous)
    (f : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (hf : ∀ N, HasCompactSupport (f N : ℝ → ℂ))
    (α : ℕ → ℝ) (hα : ∀ᶠ N in atTop, 0 < α N)
    (hmod : (fun N ↦ schwartzModularMass Φ (f N) (α N))
      =o[atTop] (fun N : ℕ ↦ (N : ℝ)))
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hlevel : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (N : ℝ)) ≤
      volume (schwartzOperatorLevelSet T (f N) (α N)))
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < α N ∧ HasCompactSupport ((α N)⁻¹ • f N : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ∧
      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Φ (‖((α N)⁻¹ • f N) x‖))) <
        ENNReal.ofReal κ * volume (schwartzOperatorLevelSet T ((α N)⁻¹ • f N) 1)

statement:
theorem nonzeroQuadraticCarlesonL0_le_oscillatory (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    (⨆ lam : {lam : ℝ // lam ≠ 0}, quadraticHilbertL0Limsup lam.1 f x) ≤
      paperOscillatoryMaximal f x + 2 * quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 f x +
      maximalErrorConstant * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x

    quadraticHilbertL0Limsup lam f x ≤ ‖paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam f x‖ₑ +
      2 * quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 f x +
      maximalErrorConstant * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.OscillatoryReduction.quadraticHilbertTrunc_enorm_le_oscillatory
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertTrunc_enorm_le_oscillatory
    (lam ε : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hε : 0 < ε) (hερ : ε ≤ innerRadius lam hlam)
    (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖quadraticHilbertTrunc lam ε f x‖ₑ ≤ ‖paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam f x‖ₑ +
      2 * quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 f x +
      maximalErrorConstant * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.OscillatoryReduction.quadraticHilbertTrunc_eq_oscillatory_reduction
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertTrunc_eq_oscillatory_reduction
    (lam ε : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hε : 0 < ε) (hερ : ε ≤ innerRadius lam hlam)
    (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    quadraticHilbertTrunc lam ε f x = paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam f x +
      (∫ y, cutoffBoundaryKernel lam (innerRadius lam hlam) (x - y) * f y) +
      quadraticHilbertTrunc 0 ε f x - quadraticHilbertTrunc 0 (innerRadius lam hlam) f x +
      ∫ y, smallPhaseKernel lam ε (innerRadius lam hlam) (x - y) * f y

name: QuadraticCarleson.PositiveStoppingBadEstimate.paperOscillatoryAction_eq_low_add_high
statement:
theorem paperOscillatoryAction_eq_low_add_high {b : ℝ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b)
    (B : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    paperOscillatoryAction lam hlam b x =
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (B+1), ∫ t, b (x-t) *
        (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam r hlam) t : ℂ) * phase (lam*t^2)) +
      ∑' n : ℕ, ∫ t, b (x-t) *
        (dyadicPsi (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam (B+n+1) hlam) t : ℂ) * phase (lam*t^2)

      lacunaryScaledEndpointConstant C * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal
        ((‖f x‖ / α) * paperLog 2 (‖f x‖ / α) ^ 2 * paperLog 4 (‖f x‖ / α))

      paperLacunaryOscillatoryMaximal f x +

        offSupportKernelAction (2 ^ n : ℝ) (j : ℝ) (packetScale N j) ((k : ℝ) + τ)‖ ≥
      ‖harmonicPhaseSum N k.toNat ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℤ) τ‖ -

theorem stationaryPacketSum_sub_kernelMain_le {N n : ℕ} {L A τ : ℝ} {k : ℤ}

    (hA : (2 : ℝ) ^ L = A) (hApos : 0 < A)
    (_hτ0 : 1 / 4 ≤ τ) (hτ1 : τ < 1 / 2) :
    ‖(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (k.toNat + 1) N,
        offSupportKernelAction (2 ^ n : ℝ) (j : ℝ) (packetScale N j) ((k : ℝ) + τ) ) -
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (k.toNat + 1) N,
        phase ((2 ^ n : ℝ) * (((k : ℝ) + τ) - j) ^ 2) /

      14 * A / N + 28 * packetScale N (k.toNat + 1)

          Real.log N / (4 * N) - counterexampleHeight c N) :

      counterexampleHeight c N ≤
        ‖quadraticHilbertSchwartz ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)
          (counterexampleSchwartz N) x‖

theorem hasUniformL0LogSquaredFrozenBlockWeakBounds_of_smoothSparse
    {A : ℝ} (hA : HasUniformFiniteRadiusSmoothSparseBound A) :
    HasUniformL0LogSquaredFrozenBlockWeakBounds
      (4 * (4 * (finiteSparseMaximalUniversalConstant * A) + 128) + 128)

name: QuadraticCarleson.HardyLittlewoodBoundaryControl.lacunary_principalValue_endpoint_of_smoothSparse
statement:
theorem lacunary_principalValue_endpoint_of_smoothSparse
    {CH : ℝ≥0∞} (hH : HasUniformHilbertMaximalWeakBound CH)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : HasUniformFiniteRadiusSmoothSparseBound A) :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0∞, K < ∞ ∧ ∀ f : L0Infinity,
      (∀ᵐ x, ∀ m : ℤ, HasQuadraticPrincipalValue (dyadicModulation m) f x
        (principalValueRepresentative (dyadicModulation m) f x)) ∧
      ∀ alpha : ℝ, 0 < alpha →
        volume {x | ENNReal.ofReal alpha < lacunaryPrincipalValueMaximal f x} ≤
          K * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal
            ((‖f x‖ / alpha) * paperLog 2 (‖f x‖ / alpha) ^ 2 *
              paperLog 4 (‖f x‖ / alpha))

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.finiteSmoothMaxOperator_neg_one_eq_conjugated
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothMaxOperator_neg_one_eq_conjugated (s : Finset PositiveSmoothRadius) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.finiteSmoothMaxOperator_scale
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothMaxOperator_scale (sigma : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (s : Finset PositiveSmoothRadius) :
    finiteSmoothMaxOperator (sigma * a ^ 2) s =
      dilatedOperator a ha (finiteSmoothMaxOperator sigma (scaleRadii a ha s))

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.hasSparseOnePBound_conjugatedOperator

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.hasSparseOnePBound_dilatedOperator_iff

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.isSparse_pullbackFamily

theorem isSparse_pullbackFamily (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.isSparse_pullbackFamily_iff

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.localAverage_conjugate
statement:
theorem localAverage_conjugate (p : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (I : RealInterval) :
    localAverage p (fun x ↦ conj (f x)) I = localAverage p f I

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.localAverage_dilate
statement:
theorem localAverage_dilate (p : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (I : RealInterval) :
    localAverage p (fun x ↦ f (x / a)) (I.dilate a ha) =
      localAverage p f I

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.locallyIntegrable_finiteSmoothMaxOperator
statement:
theorem locallyIntegrable_finiteSmoothMaxOperator

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.operatorPairing_conjugatedOperator
statement:
theorem operatorPairing_conjugatedOperator (T : TestOperator) (f g : L0Infinity) :
    operatorPairing (conjugatedOperator T) f g =
      conj (operatorPairing T (L0Infinity.conjugate f) (L0Infinity.conjugate g))

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.operatorPairing_dilatedOperator
statement:
theorem operatorPairing_dilatedOperator (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (T : TestOperator) (f g : L0Infinity) :
    operatorPairing (dilatedOperator a ha T) f g =
      a⁻¹ • operatorPairing T (L0Infinity.dilate a ha f) (L0Infinity.dilate a ha g)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.pullbackFamily_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackFamily_inverse (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (S : Set RealInterval) :
    pullbackFamily a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) (pullbackFamily a ha S) = S

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel_neg_one_eq_conj
statement:
theorem smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel_neg_one_eq_conj (ρ t : ℝ) :
    smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel (-1) ρ t =
      conj (smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel 1 ρ t)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel_scale
statement:
theorem smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel_scale (sigma : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ρ t : ℝ) :
    smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel (sigma * a ^ 2) ρ t =
      (a : ℂ) * smoothQuadraticHighPassKernel sigma (a * ρ) (a * t)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.smoothQuadraticHighPass_neg_one_eq_conj
statement:
theorem smoothQuadraticHighPass_neg_one_eq_conj (ρ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    smoothQuadraticHighPass (-1) ρ f x =
      conj (smoothQuadraticHighPass 1 ρ (fun y ↦ conj (f y)) x)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.smoothQuadraticHighPass_normalize_nonzero
statement:
theorem smoothQuadraticHighPass_normalize_nonzero {lam : ℝ} (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    smoothQuadraticHighPass lam ρ f x =
      smoothQuadraticHighPass (if lam < 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)
        (Real.sqrt |lam| * ρ) (fun u ↦ f (u / Real.sqrt |lam|))
          (Real.sqrt |lam| * x)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.smoothQuadraticHighPass_scale
statement:
theorem smoothQuadraticHighPass_scale (sigma : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ρ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    smoothQuadraticHighPass (sigma * a ^ 2) ρ f x =
      smoothQuadraticHighPass sigma (a * ρ) (fun u ↦ f (u / a)) (a * x)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.sparseForm_conjugate
statement:
theorem sparseForm_conjugate (p : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (S : Set RealInterval) :
    sparseForm p (fun x ↦ conj (f x)) (fun x ↦ conj (g x)) S = sparseForm p f g S

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.sparseForm_pullbackFamily
statement:
theorem sparseForm_pullbackFamily (p : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (S : Set RealInterval) :
    sparseForm p f g (pullbackFamily a ha S) =
      ENNReal.ofReal a⁻¹ *
        sparseForm p (fun x ↦ f (x / a)) (fun x ↦ g (x / a)) S

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.sparseOnePNorm_conjugatedOperator
statement:
theorem sparseOnePNorm_conjugatedOperator (p : ℝ) (T : TestOperator) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceySparseDilation.sparseOnePNorm_dilatedOperator
statement:
theorem sparseOnePNorm_dilatedOperator (p a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (T : TestOperator) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.L0Infinity.conjugate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_apply (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.L0Infinity.conjugate_conjugate
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_conjugate (f : L0Infinity) :
    conjugate (conjugate f) = f

name: QuadraticCarleson.L0Infinity.dilate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_apply (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.L0Infinity.dilate_dilate_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_dilate_inv (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : L0Infinity) :
    dilate a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) (dilate a ha f) = f

name: QuadraticCarleson.L0Infinity.dilate_inv_dilate
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_inv_dilate (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : L0Infinity) :
    dilate a ha (dilate a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) f) = f

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_dilate_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_dilate_inv (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :
    (I.dilate a ha).dilate a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) = I

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_injective
statement: theorem dilate_injective (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : Injective (dilate a ha)

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_inv_dilate
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_inv_dilate (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :
    (I.dilate a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha)).dilate a ha = I

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_left (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :
    (I.dilate a ha).left = a * I.left

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_length (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :
    (I.dilate a ha).length = a * I.length

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.dilate_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilate_right (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.RealInterval.preimage_mul_dilate_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimage_mul_dilate_carrier (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (I : RealInterval) :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ a * x) ⁻¹' (I.dilate a ha).carrier = I.carrier

name: QuadraticCarleson.CommonMaximalDilation.lintegral_comp_div
statement:
theorem lintegral_comp_div (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ u, F (u / a)) = ENNReal.ofReal a * ∫⁻ y, F y

name: QuadraticCarleson.CommonMaximalDilation.quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation_zero_dilate
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation_zero_dilate (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 (fun u ↦ f (u / a)) (a * x) =
      quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.CommonMaximalDilation.quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation_zero_dilate_le
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation_zero_dilate_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 (fun u ↦ f (u / a)) (a * x) ≤
      quadraticHilbertMaximalTruncation 0 f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.CommonMaximalDilation.quadraticHilbertTrunc_zero_dilate
statement:
theorem quadraticHilbertTrunc_zero_dilate (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ε : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    quadraticHilbertTrunc 0 ε (fun u ↦ f (u / a)) (a * x) =
      quadraticHilbertTrunc 0 (ε / a) f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.dyadicCutoff_lowerEndpoint_eq_zero
QuadraticCarleson.dyadicPsi_eq_zero_of_zpow_le
statement:
theorem dyadicPsi_eq_zero_of_zpow_le {j : ℤ} {t : ℝ}
    (ht : (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 1) ≤ |t|) : dyadicPsi j t = 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.exists_dyadicPsi_lower_cutoff
statement:
theorem exists_dyadicPsi_lower_cutoff {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j₀ : ℤ, dyadicCutoff ((2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ (j₀ - 1) * t) = 0 ∧
      ∀ j : ℤ, j < j₀ → dyadicPsi j t = 0

name: QuadraticCarleson.hasSum_dyadicPsi
statement:
theorem hasSum_dyadicPsi {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℤ ↦ dyadicPsi j t) (1 / t)

name: QuadraticCarleson.tsum_dyadicPsi
statement:
theorem tsum_dyadicPsi {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, dyadicPsi j t) = 1 / t

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.exists_principal_family
statement:
theorem exists_principal_family (S : Finset RealInterval) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier) :
    ∃ R : Finset RealInterval, R ⊆ S ∧ AverageSeparated f R ∧
      ∀ J ∈ S, ∃ I ∈ R, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∧
        intervalL1Average f J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average f I

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.exists_sparse_domination_finiteLaminarMaximal
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_domination_finiteLaminarMaximal
    (S : Finset RealInterval) (f g : L0Infinity)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier) :
    ∃ R : Finset RealInterval, R ⊆ S ∧ IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑R : Set RealInterval) ∧
      (∫⁻ x, (⨆ I ∈ S, ⨆ (_ : x ∈ I.carrier),
        ENNReal.ofReal (localAverage 1 f I)) * ‖g x‖ₑ) ≤
          10 * sparseForm 1 f g (↑R : Set RealInterval)

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.exists_sparse_pointwise_domination
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_pointwise_domination (S : Finset RealInterval) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier) :
    ∃ R : Finset RealInterval, R ⊆ S ∧ IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑R : Set RealInterval) ∧
      ∀ x, finiteLaminarMaximal S f x ≤ 10 * sparseAveragingFunction R f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.finiteLaminarMaximal_le_of_cover
statement:
theorem finiteLaminarMaximal_le_of_cover
    (S R : Finset RealInterval) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hcover : ∀ J ∈ S, ∃ I ∈ R, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∧
      intervalL1Average f J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average f I) (x : ℝ) :
    finiteLaminarMaximal S f x ≤ 10 * sparseAveragingFunction R f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.isSparse_of_averageSeparated
statement:
theorem isSparse_of_averageSeparated (R : Finset RealInterval) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f) (hsep : AverageSeparated f R)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑R : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨ Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier) :
    IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑R : Set RealInterval)

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.lintegral_sparseAveragingFunction_mul_enorm
statement:
theorem lintegral_sparseAveragingFunction_mul_enorm
    (R : Finset RealInterval) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (hg : Integrable g) :
    (∫⁻ x, sparseAveragingFunction R f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) =
      sparseForm 1 f g (↑R : Set RealInterval)

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteLaminarMaximalSparse.localAverage_one_eq_intervalL1Average
statement:
theorem localAverage_one_eq_intervalL1Average (f : ℝ → ℂ) (I : RealInterval) :
    localAverage 1 f I = intervalL1Average f I

name: QuadraticCarleson.FiniteSparseCommonErrorWeak.hasExtendedWeakL1Bound_of_finiteMax_add_fortyEight_maximal
statement:
theorem hasExtendedWeakL1Bound_of_finiteMax_add_fortyEight_maximal
    {N : ℕ} (T : Fin N → TestOperator) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hweak : HasWeakOneOneBound C (finiteMax T))
    (f : L0Infinity) {F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hpoint : ∀ x, F x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (finiteMax T f x) +
      48 * centeredHardyLittlewoodMaximal (fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ) x) :
    HasExtendedWeakL1Bound volume
      ((2 * C + 384) * (∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ).toReal) F

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyFiniteBlockSmoothIdentity.finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_eq_smoothHighPass_sub
statement:
theorem finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock_eq_smoothHighPass_sub
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (B : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hfi : Integrable f) (x : ℝ) :
    finiteQuadraticDyadicBlock lam j B f x =
      smoothQuadraticHighPass lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)) f x -
        smoothQuadraticHighPass lam ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2)) f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyFiniteBlockSmoothIdentity.paperLowDyadicOperator_eq_smoothHighPass_sub
statement:
theorem paperLowDyadicOperator_eq_smoothHighPass_sub
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (B : ℕ) (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    paperLowDyadicOperator lam hlam B f x =
      smoothQuadraticHighPass lam
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam - 3)) f x -
      smoothQuadraticHighPass lam
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam + (B : ℤ) - 2)) f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.lowerRadius_bracket
statement:
theorem lowerRadius_bracket (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (j : ℤ)
    (hlow : 1 ≤ a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j) (hhigh : a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / a ∧
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) / a ≤ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - 3)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.normalizedRadius_bracket
statement:
theorem normalizedRadius_bracket (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (j k : ℤ)
    (hlow : 1 ≤ a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j) (hhigh : a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + k) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / a ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / a ≤ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + k)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.paperBlockLowerRadius_bracket
statement:
theorem paperBlockLowerRadius_bracket (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' - 3) ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt lam ∧
    (1 / 4 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt lam ≤
      2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' - 3)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.paperBlockUpperRadius_bracket
statement:
theorem paperBlockUpperRadius_bracket (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (B : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' + (B : ℤ) - 2) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℤ) - 1) / Real.sqrt lam ∧
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℤ) - 1) / Real.sqrt lam ≤
      2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' + (B : ℤ) - 2)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.positiveModulation_scale_bracket
statement:
theorem positiveModulation_scale_bracket (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    1 ≤ Real.sqrt lam * (2 : ℝ) ^ oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' ∧
      Real.sqrt lam * (2 : ℝ) ^ oscillatoryScaleIndex lam 0 hlam.ne' < 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyNormalizedBlockRadii.upperRadius_bracket
statement:
theorem upperRadius_bracket (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (j : ℤ) (B : ℕ)
    (hlow : 1 ≤ a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j) (hhigh : a * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℤ) - 1) / a ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℤ) - 1) / a ≤
        2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + (B : ℤ) - 2)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyCompactPairingStabilization.dyadicSmoothHighPassMaxEnorm_eq_finiteSuffixMax_of_zero
statement:
theorem dyadicSmoothHighPassMaxEnorm_eq_finiteSuffixMax_of_zero
    (lam : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) {N : ℕ}
    (hz : ∀ r : ℕ, N ≤ r → fullDyadicConvolution lam (j + (r : ℤ)) f x = 0) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyPositiveSuffixThreeShift.exists_threeShiftForests_finitePositiveDyadicSuffixMax
statement:
theorem exists_threeShiftForests_finitePositiveDyadicSuffixMax
    (j : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (f : L0Infinity) :
    ∃ E : ℕ → Finset ℤ,
      (∀ shift,
        finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily (j + (N : ℤ) - 1) (Finset.range N) E shift ⊆
          completeFiniteShiftGridForest (j + (N : ℤ) - 1) shift N
            (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleAddresses (Finset.range N) E shift)) ∧
      ∀ x,
        ‖finitePositiveDyadicSuffixMaxOperator 1 j N f x‖ₑ ≤
          ∑ shift : Fin 3,
            localizedTailMaximal (j + 2)
              (finiteShiftGridScale (j + (N : ℤ) - 1) shift)
              (finiteOneShiftMultiscaleFamily (j + (N : ℤ) - 1)
                (Finset.range N) E shift) f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyPStoppingRecursion.finite_localized_p_stopping_step
statement:
theorem finite_localized_p_stopping_step
    (ell₀ : ℤ) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) (S : Finset RealInterval)
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (g : L0Infinity) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hfi : Integrable f) (I₀ : RealInterval)
    (hsub : ∀ J ∈ S, J.carrier ⊆ I₀.carrier)
    (hscale : ∀ J ∈ S, J.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (scale J + 2))
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier) :
    IsSparse (1 / 4) (↑(stoppingStepFamily S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀) :
      Set RealInterval) ∧
      (∀ J ∈ goodCollection S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀,
        intervalL1Average f J ≤ 10 * intervalL1Average f I₀ ∧
          (∫ x in J.carrier, ‖g x‖ ^ p) ≤
            (10 * intervalL1Average (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀) * J.length) ∧
      (∀ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀, ∀ x,
        x ∉ K.carrier →
          localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (childCollection S K) f x = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale S f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) ≤
        (∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale
          (goodCollection S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ) +
          ∑ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀,
            ∫⁻ x, localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale
              (childCollection S K) f x * ‖g x‖ₑ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyPStoppingRecursion.goodCollection_pMass_le
statement:
theorem goodCollection_pMass_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (g : L0Infinity)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {I₀ J : RealInterval}
    (hsub : ∀ K ∈ S, K.carrier ⊆ I₀.carrier)
    (hJ : J ∈ goodCollection S f (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀) :
    (∫ x in J.carrier, ‖g x‖ ^ p) ≤
      (10 * intervalL1Average (pStoppingMonitor g p hp) I₀) * J.length

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyPStoppingRecursion.localizedTailMaximal_le_monitorGood_add_children
statement:
theorem localizedTailMaximal_le_monitorGood_add_children
    (ell₀ : ℤ) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (f monitor : ℝ → ℂ) (I : RealInterval)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (x : ℝ) :
    localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale S f x ≤
      localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (goodCollection S f monitor I) f x +
        ∑ K ∈ stoppingChildren S f monitor I,
          localizedTailMaximal ell₀ scale (childCollection S K) f x

theorem exists_mem_smallestSelectedRegion_of_mem_carrier
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨
        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    {I : RealInterval} (hI : I ∈ S) {x : ℝ} (hxI : x ∈ I.carrier) :
    ∃ J ∈ S, J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∧ x ∈ smallestSelectedRegion S J

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.integrable_smallestScaleInput
statement:
theorem integrable_smallestScaleInput

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.integral_window_norm_smallestScaleInput_le
statement:
theorem integral_window_norm_smallestScaleInput_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨
        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) (f : L0Infinity) (m : ℤ)
    (hdisj : Set.Pairwise
      (↑(S.filter (fun J ↦ scale J = m)) : Set RealInterval)
      (Disjoint on RealInterval.carrier))
    {L M a b : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlen : ∀ J ∈ S.filter (fun J ↦ scale J = m), J.length ≤ L)
    (hmass : ∀ J ∈ S.filter (fun J ↦ scale J = m),
      (∫ x in J.carrier, ‖f x‖) ≤ M * J.length) :
    (∫ x in Icc a b, ‖smallestScaleInput S scale f m x‖) ≤
      M * (b - a + 2 * L)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.measurableSet_smallestSelectedRegion

theorem measurableSet_smallestSelectedRegion

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.mem_selectedSubintervals_iff
statement:
theorem mem_selectedSubintervals_iff
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {I J : RealInterval} :
    J ∈ selectedSubintervals S I ↔ J ∈ S ∧ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.mem_smallestSelectedRegion_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smallestSelectedRegion_iff
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {J : RealInterval} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ smallestSelectedRegion S J ↔
      x ∈ J.carrier ∧
        ∀ H ∈ S, H ≠ J → H.carrier ⊆ J.carrier → x ∉ H.carrier

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.norm_smallestScaleInput_eq_sum
statement:
theorem norm_smallestScaleInput_eq_sum
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨
        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖smallestScaleInput S scale f m x‖ =
      ∑ J ∈ S.filter (fun J ↦ scale J = m),
        ‖(smallestSelectedRegion S J).indicator f x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.norm_smallestScaleInput_le_norm
statement:
theorem norm_smallestScaleInput_le_norm
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦

    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.smallestSelectedRegion_disjoint

    {I J : RealInterval} (hI : I ∈ S) (hJ : J ∈ S) (hne : I ≠ J) :

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.smallestSelectedRegion_subset_carrier

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.sum_grouped_selectedRegions_centralThird_eq
statement:
theorem sum_grouped_selectedRegions_centralThird_eq
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨
        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) {I : RealInterval} (hI : I ∈ S)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    ∑ m ∈ (selectedSubintervals S I).image scale,
        ∑ J ∈ (selectedSubintervals S I).filter (fun J ↦ scale J = m),
          I.centralThird.indicator
            ((smallestSelectedRegion S J).indicator f) x =
      I.centralThird.indicator f x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.sum_indicator_smallestSelectedRegion_centralThird_eq
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_smallestSelectedRegion_centralThird_eq

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.sum_indicator_smallestSelectedRegion_eq

theorem sum_indicator_smallestSelectedRegion_eq

    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.sum_integral_norm_smallestScaleInput_le
statement:
theorem sum_integral_norm_smallestScaleInput_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectPartition.sum_integral_norm_smallestSelectedRegion_le

theorem sum_integral_norm_smallestSelectedRegion_le

    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectAction.localizedPiece_eq_sum_offset
statement:
theorem localizedPiece_eq_sum_offset
    {S : Finset RealInterval}
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun I J ↦
      I.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ J.carrier ⊆ I.carrier ∨
        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)
    (scale : RealInterval → ℤ) {I : RealInterval} (hI : I ∈ S)
    (f : L0Infinity) (x : ℝ) :
    krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (scale I) I f x =
      ∑ s ∈ offsetSet S scale,
        krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (scale I) I
          (offsetGroupedInput S scale f I s) x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectAction.localizedTailAction_activeHighCollection

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyQuadraticDirectAction.offsetGroupedInput_eq_indicator_smallestScaleInput
statement:
theorem offsetGroupedInput_eq_indicator_smallestScaleInput

        Disjoint I.carrier J.carrier)

    {I : RealInterval} (hI : I ∈ S) (f : ℝ → ℂ)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.integral_sq_localizedPiece_eq_norm_pairing
statement:
theorem integral_sq_localizedPiece_eq_norm_pairing
    (k : ℤ) (I : RealInterval) (b : ℝ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x, ‖krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I b x‖ ^ 2) =
      ‖∫ x, krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I b x *
        conj (krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I b x)‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.integral_sq_localizedPiece_le_of_adjoint_bound
statement:
theorem integral_sq_localizedPiece_le_of_adjoint_bound
    (k : ℤ) (I : RealInterval) {b : ℝ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hadj : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ I.centralThird →
      ‖(krauseLaceyPositiveKernel k).adjoint.applyIntegral
        (krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I b) x‖ ≤ H) :
    (∫ x, ‖krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I b x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      H * ∫ x in I.centralThird, ‖b x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.localUnitMass_le

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.nonstandardIntervals_subset

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.nonstandard_badPiece_diagonalEnergy_le
statement:
theorem nonstandard_badPiece_diagonalEnergy_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (I₀ : RealInterval) (k₀ k s : ℤ)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (hparent : HasDyadicParents S I₀)
    (hsub : ∀ K ∈ S, K.carrier ⊆ I₀.carrier)
    {I : RealInterval} (hscale : I.length = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2))
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ k + 2 - s)
    (hNS : IsNonstandard k I (badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (k + 2 - s))) :
    (∫ x, ‖krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 k I
      (badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (k + 2 - s)) x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (96000 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 * intervalL1Average f I₀ *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s)) *
          ∫ x in I.centralThird, ‖badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (k + 2 - s) x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.sum_nonstandard_badPiece_diagonalEnergy_le
statement:
theorem sum_nonstandard_badPiece_diagonalEnergy_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (I₀ : RealInterval) (k₀ s : ℤ) (hk₀ : 0 ≤ k₀) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (hparent : HasDyadicParents S I₀)
    (hsub : ∀ K ∈ S, K.carrier ⊆ I₀.carrier)
    (N : Finset RealInterval) (hN : N ⊆ nonstandardIntervals S f I₀ k₀ s scale) :
    (∑ I ∈ N, ∫ x, ‖krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (scale I) I
      (badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (scale I + 2 - s)) x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (96000 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 * intervalL1Average f I₀ *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s)) * ∫ x, ‖f x‖

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.aemeasurable_finitePrefixMaximal

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.coarsePrefix_sdiff_eq
statement:
theorem coarsePrefix_sdiff_eq

      if (n / 2 ^ l) % 2 = 0 then ∅ else dyadicBlock N l (n / 2 ^ l - 1)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.div_pow_succ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.eLpNorm_finitePrefixMaximal_le_log2
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_finitePrefixMaximal_le_log2
    (N : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : HasSignedSumSquareBound N v (A ^ 2)) :
    eLpNorm (finitePrefixMaximal N v) 2 μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((Nat.log2 N + 1 : ℝ) * A)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.eLpNorm_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le_log2
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le_log2
    (N : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : HasSignedSumSquareBound N v B) :
    eLpNorm (finitePrefixMaximal N v) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((Nat.log2 N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * B)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.exists_signs_sum_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem exists_signs_sum_norm_sq_le
    {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → E) :
    ∃ c : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, c i = 1 ∨ c i = -1) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ s, ‖v i‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖∑ i ∈ s, c i • v i‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.finitePrefixMaximal_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePrefixMaximal_nonneg (N : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ finitePrefixMaximal N v x

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le
statement:
theorem finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le (N d : ℕ) (hd : N < 2 ^ (d + 1))
    (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) (x : X) :
    finitePrefixMaximal N v x ^ 2 ≤
      (d + 1 : ℝ) * ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖blockSum N l q (fun i ↦ v i x)‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integrable_finitePrefixMaximal_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_finitePrefixMaximal_sq (N d : ℕ) (hd : N < 2 ^ (d + 1))
    (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ finitePrefixMaximal N v x ^ 2) μ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integrable_sq_norm_blockSum
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_norm_blockSum (N l q : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖blockSum N l q (fun i ↦ v i x)‖ ^ 2) μ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integral_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le
    (N d : ℕ) (hd : N < 2 ^ (d + 1)) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : HasSignedSumSquareBound N v B) :
    (∫ x, finitePrefixMaximal N v x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ (d + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * B

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integral_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le_log2
statement:
theorem integral_finitePrefixMaximal_sq_le_log2
    (N : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : HasSignedSumSquareBound N v B) :
    (∫ x, finitePrefixMaximal N v x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ (Nat.log2 N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * B

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integral_sq_norm_Lp
statement:
theorem integral_sq_norm_Lp (u : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    (∫ x, ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ‖u‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.integral_sq_norm_blockSum
statement:
theorem integral_sq_norm_blockSum (N l q : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    (∫ x, ‖blockSum N l q (fun i ↦ v i x)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ‖blockSum N l q v‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.memLp_finitePrefixMaximal
statement:
theorem memLp_finitePrefixMaximal (N : ℕ) (v : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    MemLp (finitePrefixMaximal N v) 2 μ

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.norm_sq_prefix_difference_le
statement:
theorem norm_sq_prefix_difference_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (N n l : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (v : ℕ → E) :
    ‖(∑ i ∈ coarsePrefix N n l, v i) -
      ∑ i ∈ coarsePrefix N n (l + 1), v i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖blockSum N l q v‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.norm_sq_prefix_le_dyadicEnergy
statement:
theorem norm_sq_prefix_le_dyadicEnergy
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (N n d : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (hd : n < 2 ^ (d + 1)) (v : ℕ → E) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (d + 1 : ℝ) * ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖blockSum N l q v‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.prefixSum_eq_sum_differences
statement:
theorem prefixSum_eq_sum_differences
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] (N n d : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (hd : n < 2 ^ (d + 1))
    (v : ℕ → E) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i) =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        ((∑ i ∈ coarsePrefix N n l, v i) -
          ∑ i ∈ coarsePrefix N n (l + 1), v i)

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.sum_norm_sq_blocks_le_signedBound
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_blocks_le_signedBound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N l : ℕ) (v : ℕ → E) {B : ℝ} (hB : HasSignedSumSquareBound N v B) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖blockSum N l q v‖ ^ 2) ≤ B

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyRademacherMenshov.sum_signed_blocks_eq
statement:
theorem sum_signed_blocks_eq
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (N l : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → E) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c q • blockSum N l q v) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, c (i / 2 ^ l) • v i

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.inner_localizedPieceLp_eq_zero_of_disjoint
statement:

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.nonstandardGenerationLp_ae_eq
statement:
theorem nonstandardGenerationLp_ae_eq

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.norm_nonstandardGenerationLp_sq_eq
statement:
theorem norm_nonstandardGenerationLp_sq_eq
    {S : Finset RealInterval} (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) (I₀ : RealInterval)
    (k₀ s : ℤ) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖nonstandardGenerationLp S f hf I₀ k₀ s scale n‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ I ∈ generation (nonstandardIntervals S f I₀ k₀ s scale) n,
        ∫ x, ‖krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (scale I) I
          (badScaleInput S f I₀ k₀ (scale I + 2 - s)) x‖ ^ 2

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.norm_nonstandardGenerationLp_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_nonstandardGenerationLp_sq_le
    {S : Finset RealInterval} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (I₀ : RealInterval) (k₀ s : ℤ) (hk₀ : 0 ≤ k₀) (scale : RealInterval → ℤ)
    (hlam : Set.Pairwise (↑S : Set RealInterval) fun J K ↦
      J.carrier ⊆ K.carrier ∨ K.carrier ⊆ J.carrier ∨ Disjoint J.carrier K.carrier)
    (hparent : HasDyadicParents S I₀)
    (hsub : ∀ K ∈ S, K.carrier ⊆ I₀.carrier) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖nonstandardGenerationLp S f hf I₀ k₀ s scale n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (96000 * positiveDyadicAmplitudeBound ^ 2 * intervalL1Average f I₀ *

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.norm_sum_sq_eq_sum_of_inner_zero
statement:

    {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

name: QuadraticCarleson.KrauseLaceyBadScale.IsEnergyStandard.localizedEnergy_le_far
